title: The Vintages Trailer Resort

services.name: Tasting Passport
services.desc: Indulge in Oregon's Willamette Valley Wine Country with our exclusive tasting passport at The Vintages, featuring complimentary tastings, enticing 2-for-1 offers, and unbeatable discounts on wine bottles at select local wineries and tasting rooms. (retail value: $325) Discover the rich flavors and scenic landscapes of our renowned wine region-all included with your stay. Book now for an unforgettable Oregon Wine Country experience. WINTER'S HILL ESTATE - SEUFERT WINERY - REMY WINES - NORTH VALLEY VINEYARDS - SOKOL BLOSSER WINERY - DUNDEE WINE LIBRARY - STOLLER FAMILY ESTATE - GROWLERS TAP STATION - DOBBES FAMILY ESTATE - BJÖRNSON VINEYARD - BRANCH POINT DISTILLERY - PIKE ROAD WINES - RAW

blurb: The Vintages Trailer Resort offers premier Airstream glamping in Oregon's famed Willamette Valley. Nestled in wine country, we feature 34 fully restored and custom fabricated trailers complete with outdoor grills and cruiser bikes for maximizing warm summer days.
